requirements.summary: A modern, clean landing page template for a healthcare SaaS product, featuring a split hero section with distinct background colors, a logo cloud, and a clear typographic hierarchy.
requirements.template_goal: Create a reusable, easily themeable landing page template with clear separation of layout, styling, and content. Use Tailwind CSS for styling and structure the HTML to allow easy swapping of text, images, and colors.
hard_constraints: Match the split hero layout exactly with the specific background colors.
Use a serif font for main headings and the logo, and a sans-serif font for body text and UI elements.
Implement the specific border radii on cards (approx 16px-24px) and buttons (approx 8px-12px).

section_requirements.name: Header
section_requirements.layout: Flexbox, space-between, items-center, sticky top, padding x-8 y-4
styling: CTA button primary-dark background, white text, rounded-button
behaviors: Dropdown indicators (carets) for 'Resources' and 'What We Offer'

section_requirements.name: Hero
section_requirements.purpose: Main value proposition and visual demonstration
section_requirements.layout: CSS Grid, 2 columns (approx 40/60 split), gap-6, padding x-8
styling: Left card: surface-light-green bg, radius-card, flex col, justify-between, padding-12
Right card: surface-light-blue bg, radius-card, flex row, items-center, justify-center, relative overflow-hidden
Large CTA button in left card: primary-dark bg, white text, flex justify-between items-center, full width or large width
copy_items: Admit more patients, reduce staff burden, and get paid faster with an AI-native system built for behavioral healthcare.
assets: UI mockup elements (CRM, EHR, RCM cards, user avatars, charts)
behaviors: Hover effect on 'Request a Demo' button

section_requirements.name: Logo Cloud
section_requirements.layout: Flex col, items-center, gap-8, padding y-12
styling: Logos: flex row, wrap, justify-center, gap-12, items-center, grayscale/muted

section_requirements.name: Features Preview
section_requirements.purpose: Introduce specific use cases or features
section_requirements.layout: Grid or Flex, starting with a left-aligned card, padding x-8
styling: Card: surface-light-green bg, radius-card, padding-12, min-h-[300px]
Badge: bg-badge, radius-badge, text-sm, padding x-4 y-1, inline-block

layout_requirements: Use a max-width container for the main content to ensure it doesn't stretch too far on ultra-wide screens.
Maintain consistent padding on the left and right edges of the page (e.g., px-8).
The hero section must use a grid layout to achieve the specific split card design.
styling_requirements: Configure Tailwind with the specific brand colors provided in the design tokens.
Set up custom font families in Tailwind config for the serif and sans-serif fonts.
Ensure the UI mockup in the right hero card is built using HTML/CSS elements (divs, spans, svgs) rather than a single static image to allow for future animation and editability.
copy_requirements: Use the exact copy visible in the reference image for the header, hero, and logo cloud sections.
asset_requirements: Use SVG icons for the logo leaf, navigation carets, and the arrow in the hero CTA.
If exact investor logos are unavailable, use clean, text-based SVG placeholders that match the visual weight of the originals.
behavior_requirements: Navigation items with dropdowns should show a visual change on hover.
Primary CTA buttons should have a slight scale or brightness change on hover.
structure_guidance: Use semantic HTML tags: <header> for the top nav, <main> for the page content, <section> for distinct areas like the hero and logo cloud.
Create a reusable configuration object or constants file at the top of the script for navigation links, copy, and logo paths to make the template easy to update.
execution_plan: 1. Initialize HTML skeleton and configure Tailwind CSS with custom colors, fonts, and border radii.
2. Build the Header component: implement flex layout, insert logo, map over navigation links, and style the 'Book a Demo' button.
3. Construct the Hero section container using CSS Grid with a 2-column layout and gap.
4. Build the left Hero card: apply light green background, large padding, serif headline, sans-serif body, and the dark green 'Request a Demo' button.
5. Build the right Hero card: apply light blue background, center content. Recreate the internal UI mockup (CRM, EHR, RCM cards) using nested flex/grid layouts, white backgrounds, and subtle shadows.
6. Build the Logo Cloud section: add the centered text and a flex container for the logos. Insert SVG logos or placeholders.
7. Build the initial part of the Features Preview section: create the light green card and the 'Broad clinical support' badge.
8. Perform a final review against the reference image, adjusting padding, font sizes, and colors to match as closely as possible.
known_unknowns: The exact font families used in the original design.
The content and layout of the dropdown menus in the header.
The full layout of the 'Features Preview' section, as only the top portion is visible.
acceptance_criteria: The hero section features two distinct cards side-by-side with the correct background colors and border radii.
Typography clearly distinguishes between serif headings and sans-serif body text.
The UI mockup in the right hero card is constructed with HTML/CSS, not a single image.
The layout is responsive, stacking the hero cards on smaller screens (though desktop is the primary target).

validation.summary: The candidate provides a strong structural foundation and matches the overall layout, typography, and color scheme well. However, there are several noticeable visual discrepancies in the hero section's UI mockup (missing connecting lines, incorrect label styling) and the logo cloud (logos are too light) that need to be addressed to achieve high fidelity.
strengths: Excellent use of the configuration object for easy editability.
Correct application of brand colors and typography.
The split hero layout and card border radii match the reference well.
Good semantic structure and responsive considerations.

issues.title: Missing pill badges for UI mockup labels
issues.observed: The labels 'CRM', 'EHR', and 'RCM' below the white cards in the right hero section are plain text.
issues.expected: These labels should be enclosed in small, white, pill-shaped badges with a subtle shadow, as seen in the reference.
issues.fix_instructions: Wrap the 'CRM', 'EHR', and 'RCM' text spans in the right hero card with classes like `bg-white px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] shadow-sm`.

issues.title: Logo cloud logos are too light
issues.observed: The logos in the 'Backed by leading investors' section use `text-gray-400`, making them much lighter than the reference.
issues.expected: The logos should have a darker, higher-contrast appearance, closer to dark gray or black.
issues.fix_instructions: Change `text-gray-400` to `text-gray-800` or `text-gray-900` for all logo elements in the logo cloud section.

issues.title: Missing connecting lines in UI mockup
issues.observed: The three white cards (CRM, EHR, RCM) in the right hero section are floating independently without visual connection.
issues.expected: There should be faint, branching connecting lines linking the cards together to illustrate a system flow.
issues.fix_instructions: Add an absolutely positioned SVG behind the three cards (ensure cards have `relative z-10`) that draws faint gray lines connecting them. A simple path connecting the center points will suffice.

issues.title: Hero CTA card padding is too large
issues.observed: The dark green 'Request a Demo' card in the left hero section has `py-6`, making it taller than the reference.
issues.expected: The CTA card should be slightly shorter to match the proportions in the reference image.
issues.fix_instructions: Reduce the vertical padding on the 'Request a Demo' anchor tag from `py-6` to `py-4` or `py-5`.

issues.title: Generic avatar in CRM card
issues.observed: The CRM card uses a generic SVG user icon.
issues.expected: The reference shows a photographic avatar.
issues.fix_instructions: Replace the SVG user icon in the CRM card with an `` tag using a placeholder image (e.g., `https://i.pravatar.cc/150?img=1`) with `w-full h-full object-cover`.

patch_instructions: In the Logo Cloud section, find all instances of `text-gray-400` on the logo spans and replace them with `text-gray-800` to increase contrast.
In the left Hero column, locate the 'Request a Demo' anchor tag and change its vertical padding from `py-6` to `py-4`.

In the right Hero column's UI mockup, locate the spans containing the text 'CRM', 'EHR', and 'RCM' (e.g., `CRM`). Update their classes to `bg-white px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-text-primary tracking-wide shadow-sm`.
In the CRM card within the UI mockup, replace the generic SVG user icon inside the `w-8 h-8 rounded-full` div with an image tag: ``.

To add the connecting lines in the right Hero card, add `relative z-10` to the three flex containers holding the CRM, EHR, and RCM cards. Then, insert an absolutely positioned SVG as the first child of the `max-w-lg` container (with `absolute inset-0 z-0 pointer-events-none`) containing paths that draw faint gray lines between the cards.
